tagline.en: The eastern road from Beijing to Guangzhou, through Hengshui, Puyang, Huanggang and the hills of eastern Hunan, with a Yellow River bridge rebuilt twice in thirty years
tagline.zh: 从北京到广州的东路：经衡水、濮阳、黄冈和湘东山区，所过的黄河大桥三十年间两度改建

start.en: Caihuying Bridge, Fengtai, Beijing, on the south-west Second Ring Road — kilometre 0
start.zh: 北京市丰台区菜户营桥（西南二环）——零公里

end.en: The Helong Road junction on the Guanghua road, Baiyun, Guangzhou, where it meets G107
end.zh: 广州市白云区广花公路鹤龙路口，与 107 国道相接

en: G106 runs 2,476 km from Caihuying Bridge in Beijing to the northern edge of Guangzhou, through Beijing, Hebei, Henan, Shandong, Hubei, Hunan and Guangdong. It takes a line east of the main north–south corridor: Gu'an, Bazhou, Renqiu, Hejian, Hengshui, Nangong, Wei county, Guantao and Daming in Hebei; Nanle, Qingfeng and Puyang in Henan; across the Yellow River into Dongming, the only Shandong county on the route; then Lankao, Qi county, Taikang, Huaiyang, Xiangcheng, Xincai and Huangchuan. In Hubei it passes Macheng and Huanggang, crosses the Yangtze to Ezhou and runs by Daye, Tongshan, Chongyang and Tongcheng; in Hunan it climbs through Pingjiang, Liuyang, Liling, You county, Chaling, Yanling, Guidong and Rucheng to the Guangdong border, and comes down by Renhua and Fogang to Guangzhou.

In southern Beijing the road is tangled up with the Beijing–Kaifeng expressway: between Yuquanying and Shuangyuan bridges it runs on the expressway's main carriageway, and south of Shuangyuan the expressway's service road is G106 itself. The 1981 route was 2,466 km.
zh: G106 自北京菜户营桥至广州北郊，全长 2476 公里，途经北京、河北、河南、山东、湖北、湖南、广东。它走的是南北主通道以东的一线：河北境内经固安、霸州、任丘、河间、衡水、南宫、威县、馆陶、大名；河南境内经南乐、清丰、濮阳；跨黄河进入沿线唯一的山东县份东明；再经兰考、杞县、太康、淮阳、项城、新蔡、潢川。湖北境内经麻城、黄冈，跨长江至鄂州，经大冶、通山、崇阳、通城；湖南境内经平江、浏阳、醴陵、攸县、茶陵、炎陵、桂东、汝城至湘粤边界，再经仁化、佛冈南下广州。
在北京南部，这条路与京开高速公路交织在一起：玉泉营桥至双源桥段与京开高速主路共线，双源桥以南的京开高速辅路即为 G106 正线。1981 年线路全长 2466 公里。

en: The Yellow River crossing is the Dongming Yellow River Highway Bridge between Dongming in Shandong and Puyang county in Henan: 4,142.14 m long and 18.5 m wide, four lanes, the longest highway bridge in Shandong. It was designed by the Henan transport planning and design institute, begun on 30 October 1991 and finished in 1993; sources disagree on the month — the Shandong local chronicle archive gives the end of August for the main works, other reports September or December.

Traffic and overloaded lorries wore it out. In February 2010 the Research Institute of Highway of the transport ministry rated it a category-IV bridge, and from May 2010 vehicles over 30 tonnes or 3 m high were barred. The repair, begun in December 2014, added low towers and stay cables to the main bridge, turning a continuous rigid frame into an extradosed cable-stayed bridge — a conversion the bridge's managers described as a first in China and in Asia. It reopened on 16 June 2017. A new bridge alongside on the downstream side, its deck 4 m from the old one, 7.62 km of six-lane class-I road with a 5.57 km main bridge, designed for 100 km/h, was begun on 27 August 2021 and opened on 30 June 2025.
The Yangtze crossing between Huanggang and Ezhou is the E'huang Yangtze River Bridge, a cable-stayed bridge 3,245 m long with a 480 m main span, built in 1999–2002.
zh: 黄河上的通道是位于山东东明与河南濮阳县之间的东明黄河公路大桥：全长 4142.14 米，宽 18.5 米，双向四车道，是山东省境内最长的公路大桥。大桥由河南省交通规划勘察设计院设计，1991 年 10 月 30 日开工，1993 年建成；具体月份说法不一——山东地情档案记全桥主体工程 1993 年 8 月底竣工，另有报道作 9 月或 12 月。

交通量激增和超载车辆使大桥不堪重负。2010 年 2 月，经交通运输部公路科学研究院检测，大桥被评定为四类桥；2010 年 5 月起，禁止总重超过 30 吨和高度超过 3 米的车辆通行。2014 年 12 月开工的改造工程在主桥上增设矮塔和斜拉索，将连续刚构体系改造为矮塔斜拉桥体系——大桥管理处称这在国内是首次，在亚洲也数首次。大桥于 2017 年 6 月 16 日恢复通车。新桥紧贴老桥下游侧建设，两桥桥面间距 4 米，路线全长 7.62 公里，主桥 5.57 公里，按双向六车道一级公路、设计时速 100 公里建设，2021 年 8 月 27 日开工，2025 年 6 月 30 日建成通车。
黄冈与鄂州之间的长江上是鄂黄长江大桥，为斜拉桥，全长 3245 米，主跨 480 米，1999—2002 年建成。

en: G106 is one of the twelve radial routes out of Beijing in the national trunk highway plan issued in November 1981, and the 2013 plan kept its two ends, with the listed length rising from 2,466 to 2,476 km. The Dongming bridge was planned from 1986, when the Shandong transport department surveyed sites three times, and the Ministry of Communications approved the design brief on behalf of the State Planning Commission in August 1987. The name on the bridge was written by the head of state.
zh: 1981 年 11 月发布的《国家干线公路网（试行方案）》中，G106 是 12 条首都放射线之一；2013 年规划保留了起讫点，里程由 2466 公里变为 2476 公里。东明黄河公路大桥的筹建始于 1986 年：当年山东省交通厅先后三次组织设计、勘探桥位，1987 年 8 月交通部代国家计委批复设计任务书。桥名由江泽民题写。

en: The 1993 Dongming bridge cost 235 million yuan, raised mainly by the Shandong transport department and the Zhongyuan Petroleum Exploration Bureau. After its 2017 repair it was free to cross. The driver's mate on a lorry first in the queue for the reopening told the Qilu Evening News that, with expressway tolls high, they mostly kept to ordinary roads, and that the free bridge was better and cheaper than the detour by the Yellow River pontoon bridges. The new bridge cost 2.045 billion yuan and is tolled: Shandong set its toll rates from 30 June 2025, on a trial basis until 29 June 2027, for the project company, CCCC (Dongming) Investment and Construction.
zh: 1993 年的东明黄河公路大桥总投资 2.35 亿元，主要由山东省交通厅和中原石油勘探局集资筹建。2017 年改造完成后免费通行。排在等候通车队伍第一位的货车跟车人员对《齐鲁晚报》说，由于高速费用较高，他们大多走普通公路；大桥免费通行，比起绕道黄河浮桥，不仅路况好，还能省钱。新桥总投资 20.45 亿元，实行收费：山东省自 2025 年 6 月 30 日起为项目公司中交（东明）投资建设有限公司试行车辆通行费标准，有效期至 2027 年 6 月 29 日。

why.en: No cost exists for the whole road, which links older provincial roads and is rebuilt section by section. Sourced costs for the Yellow River crossing are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价：它连接各省原有道路，分段改建、分段计价。下列为黄河大桥有来源的造价。

why.en: No route-wide funding statement has been found. The 1993 Dongming bridge was funded mainly by the Shandong transport department and the Zhongyuan Petroleum Exploration Bureau; the 2025 bridge is a tolled project of a CCCC project company.
why.zh: 未查到全线出资说明。1993 年的东明黄河公路大桥主要由山东省交通厅和中原石油勘探局集资；2025 年的新桥由中交项目公司投资建设并收费。

timeline.en: The national trunk highway plan of November names Beijing–Guangzhou as G106.
timeline.zh: 11 月，《国家干线公路网（试行方案）》将北京至广州公路编为 106 国道。

timeline.en: The design brief for the Dongming Yellow River bridge is approved in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月，东明黄河公路大桥设计任务书获批复。

timeline.en: Work on the Dongming bridge begins on 30 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 30 日，东明黄河公路大桥开工。

timeline.en: The Dongming Yellow River Highway Bridge is finished.
timeline.zh: 东明黄河公路大桥建成通车。

timeline.en: The E'huang Yangtze River Bridge opens.
timeline.zh: 鄂黄长江大桥建成通车。

timeline.en: The Dongming bridge is rated category IV in February; heavy and tall vehicles are barred from May.
timeline.zh: 2 月，东明黄河公路大桥被评定为四类桥；5 月起限载限高。

timeline.en: Work to convert the Dongming bridge to an extradosed cable-stayed bridge begins in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，东明黄河公路大桥矮塔斜拉改造工程开工。

timeline.en: The repaired Dongming bridge reopens on 16 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 16 日，改造后的东明黄河公路大桥恢复通车。

timeline.en: Work on the new Dongming bridge begins on 27 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 27 日，东明黄河公路大桥改扩建工程开工。

timeline.en: The new six-lane Dongming bridge opens on 30 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 30 日，双向六车道的东明黄河公路大桥新桥通车。
